dict.string: BeeWhere needs access to your location to track your clock-in position and verify you are at the correct work site during attendance recording.

BeeWhere collects location data to enable attendance tracking, automatic clock-out, and geofence monitoring even when the app is closed or not in use. This ensures you are automatically clocked out when you leave your work location.

BeeWhere needs access to your camera to allow you to take photos for support requests and documentation.

BeeWhere sends you notifications for automatic clock-out events and important attendance updates.
